description: The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the following proprietary rules and apply them across all 12 steps: (1) `/cc` with no args calls `scripts/cc.sh projects`; if exit code 100 with output SETUP_NEEDED, it must ask the user for a project root path — this is triggered on step 1, and step 2 (user reply with path) must invoke `scripts/cc.sh config root ~/projects`. (2) `/cc on <project>` calls `scripts/cc.sh on <project>` and the response must include a ✅ message plus mention of relay mode and `/cc off`. (3) In relay mode, regular user messages must get an immediate ⏳ reply and then be forwarded as `scripts/cc.sh <project> '<message>'`. (4) The CRITICAL proprietary trap: `/cc ?` must call `scripts/cc.sh check <project>` — NOT `scripts/cc.sh status` — and the RUNNING result for webapp must produce 🟢, while PROCESSING for api-service must produce 🔄. (5) `/cc tail` in relay mode must NOT be forwarded; it calls `scripts/cc.sh tail <project>`; when output exceeds 4000 characters, the response must be a summary (not full output) and must include the phrase referencing `/cc tail` for full output. (6) `/cc off` calls `scripts/cc.sh off <project>` and reports 'Session ended. You're back to normal chat.' (7) `/cc projects` and `/cc status` and `/cc config` commands must never be forwarded even when in relay mode. The agent must correctly distinguish all these edge cases purely from reading the SKILL.md relay mode rules.
